positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Azure DevOps Services, Docker Products and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Contributed to the development of a data surveillance mobile application used by many local and federal enforcement agencies
• Ported a feature from the desktop application over to the mobile application to allow agencies to track a particular type of call
• Refactored and migrated pre-existing code over to multiple new technologies such as Xamarin Shell and MAUI to ensure long-term viability
• Assisted in upgrading the application codebase to a new framework to leverage enhanced features and improve performance
• Resolved bugs relating to both user interface and backend development, improving functionality and user experience
• Collaborated with team members in an environment that used Agile Software Development principles and Scrum Methodologies
• Acquired professional experience working with technologies including C#, .NET, XAML, Xamarin, MAUI, and Azure DevOps
positions.insights: Azure DevOps Services, Git and +7 skills

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Interacted and built positive relationships with volunteers who possessed their own unique and diverse backgrounds
- Facilitated the distribution of necessities and ensured unfortunate families were receiving needed assistance
- Handed out food, medicine, sanitary products, and children entertainment to over 50 families in need at a special event
- Participated in labor work such as carrying pallets, mopping the entire warehouse, and organizing hundreds of foods and drinks.

projects.title: Customer Freight Tracking Application (Senior Design)
projects.description:
• Developed an in-house customer freight tracking application to replace a limited third party software used by the sponsor
• Recognized as an Individual Rockstar Award Winner for contributing to an overall final product and growth of team members
• Lead team discussions related to eliciting requirements and development architecture
• Conducted in-depth code reviews of pull requests and code implementations from all team members
• Resolved any code conflicts or issues encountered by all team members and also engaged in pair programming to provide further assistance
• Managed Agile Scrum sprint planning through Jira and designated stories to team members along with context and resources based on a volunteering system
• Engaged in professional conversations with sponsors during meetings to gain feedback and gauge necessary requirements

projects.title: E-Commerce Online Store Web Application
projects.description:
- Lead and scheduled group discussions as well as designated tasks to team members along with a plethora of resources
- Voluntarily took on additional tasks and research to further improve my software engineering skills
- Facilitated any issues encountered among team members to help maintain cooperation and a healthy environment towards finishing a presentable application
- Gained further in-depth knowledge on working with an MVC architecture regarding both front-end and back-end
